notes: Batch 2026-W48. Harvests read: 2026-11-23 (272 items; the scheduled Monday harvest and source check did not run again, dispatched by hand 14:12 UTC, done 14:29). Shortlist harvest of 25 links; two preview rounds (30 sets, about 470 photos) plus last week's contact sheets for runner-ups (Ryder, Mr C, Bavel, Rochechouart), every listed photo viewed. Eight posts, not ten: see the weekly email for what fell out and why.

card: THE TUSK BAR AND BRASS. TIN PAN ALLEY, NEW YORK.
INSIDE THE EVELYN, AN ART DECO BUILDING OF 1903.
AN OYSTER BAR, THEN A GRAND DINING ROOM.
A VINTAGE TAXIDERMY OSTRICH WATCHES THE ROOM.
posts.alt_hint: A low-lit cocktail bar with a curved fluted bar front, green stools, red velvet curtains and palms under a skylight.
posts.facts_from: Islyn Studio project page (The Evelyn hotel, Art Deco building built in 1903 on Tin Pan Alley; oyster bar then Brass; taxidermy ostrich; Esquire Best Bars in America 2024; year 2024).

posts.bring: BRING WHOEVER YOU OWE A DINNER.
card: KIMPTON ERA. ROCKEFELLER CENTER, NEW YORK.
A BLACKENED STEEL STAIR IN A FLUTED ATRIUM.
A SCARLET CERAMIC BAR, MOSAIC FLOORS.
posts.alt_hint: A hotel brasserie bar with a long scarlet ceramic counter, round leather stools and a patterned mosaic floor.
posts.facts_from: Dezeen 2026-10-03 (529 keys, 33-storey tower on West 48th Street, blackened steel stair in a three-storey fluted atrium, second-floor brasserie with scarlet ceramic bar and mosaic floors, ocean liner references, INC).

card: THE OLDEST OPERATING HOTEL IN PALM SPRINGS.
FOUNDED IN THE 1920S BY HARRIET CODY.
A CLASS I HISTORIC SITE. 29 ROOMS.
posts.alt_hint: A small desert hotel pool with scalloped white umbrellas and loungers, bougainvillea and the San Jacinto Mountains behind.
posts.facts_from: Electric Bowery project page (Palm Springs 2021, photography by Lance Gerber & Josh Cho; oldest operating hotel in Palm Springs, founded in the 1920s by Harriet Cody, cousin to Buffalo Bill; Class I Historic Site; 29 rooms; Spanish Colonial Revival).
